Hi Laura and Susan,

Following our demo last week, ACME is ready to begin org creation and initial access seeding. Susan, thanks for confirming the primary contacts — looping Rodolfo for procurement visibility.

High level ask: we want an operational plan that covers (A) admin and role mapping (B) ephemeral API key seeding for service accounts (C) invite cadence for end users and SOC2-relevant logging for the first 90 days. Can Laura or Jonas own the technical handoff and provide a concrete schedule?

Proposed start: Wednesday 7/2 for admin roster import, followed by a one-hour implementation kickoff with Jonas and Neha.

Attachments: brief with our suggested role matrix (acme-roles-mapping.csv).

Thanks,
Monica

Subject: Re: Kickoff — initial access curation + seeding plan

Thanks Monica — happy to own the handoff. Jonas will lead the implementation sprint; Neha will validate the ephemeral key flow and audit logging.

Quick responses to your bullets:
- Admin/roles: we reviewed the CSV and propose a small change to map "Platform Admin" -> "redwood:org_admin" for ACME's SSO group. I'll attach an updated matrix after today's sync.
- Ephemeral keys: we recommend seeding 2 service accounts with short-lived ephemeral credentials (30m TTL) for initial integration testing, then expanding to a production pair once the audit hooks are verified.
- Invite cadence: seed 5 admin invites Thursday 7/3, then a staggered invite of 20 end users on 7/7. We will hold off on bulk invites until the KV caching policy is tuned.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Implementation kickoff: Wed 7/2 11:00-12:00 PT (Zoom) — Jonas to lead (agenda: role mapping, API key flow, SSO groups, audit exports).
2) Deliverables by EOD 7/2: updated role matrix, ephemeral keying sequence (spreadsheet), and a short runbook for admin invites.
3) Security review checkpoint with ACME security: Fri 7/4 09:00 PT (Neha to join).

I attached the playbook skeleton and the initial ephemeral-keying spreadsheet for review. Please confirm the kickoff time or suggest a window.

Best,
Laura Bennett

Thanks Susan — answers inline and next steps below.

On SSO group attribute: please map ACME_RI_Admins -> SAML attribute 'groups' with value exactly 'ACME_RI_Admins'. Redwood checks the 'groups' claim; mapping will be redwood:org_admin when present. I'll paste the formal attribute snippet in the Drive doc (see link).

On audit exports: we provide daily JSON exports with the following minimal schema: timestamp, actor_email, action, resource_type, resource_id, request_context (ip, user_agent), and result_code. Retention options: by default we retain 90 days on-host; customers can configure an automated export to an S3 bucket or push to an HTTP endpoint. Splunk integration: we have a simple Lambda-to-Splunk example that ACME can reuse (link in Drive). Neha will bring the sample export during the kickoff and validate the Splunk forwarder.

Delivery items (owner / ETA):
- Updated role matrix (laura_bennett) / 7/2 EOD — attached (ACME_Onboard_Playbook_v1.pdf contains the summary).
- Ephemeral keying sequence (jonas_weber) / 7/2 EOD — see ephemeral-keying-sequence.xlsx. Jonas: we will seed two service accounts with 30m TTL tokens; please include the CLI commands and the Terraform snippet for the service-account resource.
- Admin invite runbook (neha_kapoor) / 7/3 AM — Neha will provide the invite checklist and the audit steps to confirm org_admins can view audit exports.

Kickoff confirmed: Wed 7/2 11:00-12:00 PT — Zoom invite is on the calendar. Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/987654321 (agenda in Drive).

If there are any procurement pre-reqs (PO numbers, contact for billing), Rodolfo — can you share the contact here so procurement@acmehealth.com and our Finance Ops can align?

Thanks everyone — we'll run the playbook and iterate.

Regards,
Laura
